description.narrative: The project is implemented in Sweden and the Palme Center's programme countries. The main outcome area it contributes to is quality assurance, with regards to integration of an environment and climate perspective. Through ensuring that systems, resources, capacity and knowledge for working with environment and climate exist and function effectively, the project aims to strengthen the Palme Centers and its partners capacity to work with and promote the environment and climate perspective.Project OrganisationsThe project is an internal project implemented by Olof Palme International Center.Other Donors to the OrganisationSOLIDAR has also contributed funds in a joint project on Just Transition during 2022.Project ObjectiveThe Palme Center and its partner organisations have strengthened their systems, capacity, resources and knowledge to work with environment and climate and is actively promoting the environment and climate perspective in all areas of their operations.
